{npc:Tereban}, in Edron, wants to give special presents to his four children (a knight, a sorcerer, a druid and a paladin), who share the same birthday. The craftsmen need eight rare components hidden in dungeons all over the continent. Find them all and hand them to Tereban to receive 28,000 experience, 8,000 gp and the {item:Old Cape}.
A father wants to give presents to his four children on the birthday they share.
Tereban, Mirabell's tavern (above the Edron depot)
First mission of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} completed (access to Farmine).
First mission of {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest} completed (access to the Isle of the Kings).
{spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) to go down and back up the mountain between Farmine and the Zao Steppe (Exquisite Silk).
to open the hole on the Isle of the Kings
or a melee weapon, to cut through the spider webs
{spell:Levitate} or parcels/boxes for the Farmine mountain (Zao)
2,500 experience for each component delivered (8 components)
8,000 extra experience at the end (28,000 in total)
The {item:Old Cape} you receive at the end is the item required for this addon.
You can fetch the components in **any order** and you don't need to hand one in before going to fetch another. Gather several and hand them all in at once.
Each component sits behind a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door} inside a different dungeon: plan the route through the nearest cities (see the table in section 1).

Go to **Edron** and climb to {npc:Mirabell}'s tavern, above the depot. Talk to {npc:Tereban}: say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He asks you for the pieces for a sorcerer robe, a paladin bow, a knight shield and a druid wand.

If you are not in Edron, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the **Edron** port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}; the depot and the tavern are in the centre of the city.
These are the components and the nearest city for each one. For each one you hand in, you receive 2,500 experience.
Go to {wiki:Edron Wyvern Hill} and make your way to the far **east**. The hill is **north** of Edron ({coord:33221,31769,7}): leave the city to the north, on foot.
Edron Wyvern Hill map: the ramp

On the **north** side there is a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door}. Go in, climb the ramp and kill {creature:Heoni} (he is roughly as strong as a Wyvern). 'Use' Heoni's corpse to get the {item:Strong Sinew}. You don't have to be the one who kills him: just using the corpse is enough. Then go down the ramp, leave through the quest door and go back across the hill the same way to Edron.
Map: quest door location on Edron Wyvern Hill
The quest door on the north side

Go to **Svargrond**: take the boat in **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore** (tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city. In **Svargrond**, leave the city to the **west**. Keep going west over the mountain, go down the stairs and head west to the raider camp. If you have already done the Barbarian Test, you can travel with {npc:Buddel} to the **raider camps**. With Buddel (**south** of Svargrond) say {key:hi}, {key:passage} and {key:camp}: he drops you by the barbarian camps ({coord:32020,31294,7}), south of Bittermor.
{npc:Buddel} is always drunk and sometimes takes you to the wrong island: if that happens, ask him for the destination again.

Head **north** across the thin layer of ice to {wiki:Bittermor}, the glacier camp in the north. Just **north** of the camp entrance there is a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door}. Go in and open the crate to receive the {item:Exquisite Wood}.
Bittermor map with the quest door

Go back the same way: leave the quest door, cross the ice **south** to the raider camp and head **east** over the mountain to Svargrond. If you came with {npc:Buddel}, talk to him by the camps and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}. Then take {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat to the city of your choice.
Get to the Isle of the Kings

In **Carlin**, go to {npc:Dalbrect}'s boat, at the harbour **north and west** of the city (north of the {wiki:Ghostlands|Ghostlands}). Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}: he takes you to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} for 10 gp (only after the first mission of {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}). On the island, the entrance to the catacombs is in the large monks' building.
Don't enter the restricted area on the 3rd floor of the monastery: if you do, you have to pay a fine to {npc:Costello} ({key:absolution}), otherwise Dalbrect won't take you to or from the island.
Go to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} and go down to the **6th floor** of the catacombs.
Isle of the Kings: the passage from the boat
There are lesser {wiki:Undead|undead} and {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}.
Open the hole with the pick
Head **northwest** to the end and use the {item:Pick} on the shadow of a {item:Stone Pillar} to open a hole.
Use the Pick behind the pillar
6th floor of the catacombs: green = use the Pick behind the pillar
The spot where you use the Pick, in the pillar's shadow
Go down the hole to the **7th floor** and head **west** until you find the {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door}. Go in and open the chest to receive the {item:Spectral Cloth}.
Map of the 7th floor to the quest door
Leave the Isle of the Kings

Go back the same way: head back **east** to the hole you opened with the {item:Pick} and use the {item:Rope} to climb to the 6th floor. Then go up all the catacomb floors to the monks' building and go to the boat. Talk to {npc:Dalbrect} ({key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}) to return to Carlin.
Hole opened with the Pick (climb with Rope)

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}. In Farmine go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain. Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} at {coord:33085,31532,7}. From there head **northeast** to the central orc camp, where {npc:Curos} is.
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe
Go to the {wiki:Zao Wailing Widow Cave}. The entrance is **northeast** of the central orc camp in Zao. It is **east** of {npc:Curos} and south of the Dragonblaze Peaks.
The entrance of the Zao Wailing Widow Cave
The ramp from the cave to the surface

From the first-floor ramp head **southwest** and break the {item:Spider Webs|spider webs} with your weapon or with the {item:Firebug}. Go through the opening and go down the ramp at the end of the passage.
First floor: yellow = spider webs, green = ramp to the next area

Head **southwest** and follow the cave **south**, then **southeast**, until it turns **northeast**. Break another set of webs and keep going northeast looking for a ramp next to the **south** wall of the cave. Go down it: you are on the last floor.
Second floor: yellow = spider webs, green = ramp to the next area

Head **west** and go through the {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door} into a room with **4 {creature:Wailing Widow|Wailing Widows}**. Kill them and 'Use' the {item:Spider Victim} in the middle of the room to get the {item:Exquisite Silk}.
Last floor: path to the quest door
Leave the Zao Wailing Widow Cave

Go back the same way: go up the two ramps (if the webs have come back, break them again) to the exit ({coord:33223,31397,7}). On the steppe go back to the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine. There talk to {npc:Thorgrin}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}.

Go to **Ankrahmun** (by boat: tell the harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}) and leave the city by the **northeast** ramp. Follow the city walls **south** to the southeast part of {wiki:Darama}. Use the {item:Shovel} to dig open the entrance to the {wiki:Shadow Tomb} and go in.
Dig the Shadow Tomb entrance here
The spot where you dig the Shadow Tomb entrance

Go down to the **5th floor** and go to the **north** part of that floor, where there is a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door}. Go in and use the sarcophagus on the **north** side of the room to get the {item:Magic Crystal}.
Shadow Tomb map to the quest door
The quest door on the 5th floor

Go back the same way: go up the 5 floors of the {wiki:Shadow Tomb} to the entrance and use the {item:Rope} on the hole you dug to come out into the desert ({coord:33255,32833,7}). Then return to **Ankrahmun** via the city's **northeast** ramp.

Take a boat to **Port Hope** (say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain); you arrive at {npc:Charles}'s dock. From Port Hope cross the Tiquanda jungle **northeast** to {wiki:Banuta} ({coord:32807,32542,7}). If you have the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek}, at the far **east** of Port Hope, takes you straight to Banuta for 30 gp.
In Banuta, go down the stairs furthest **south**.
Keep heading **north** until you reach the {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door}. Go in and open the crate to get the {item:Mystic Root}.
Underground Banuta: yellow = start, green = quest door

Go back the same way: head **south** to the stairs and go up to the surface, on the **south** side of Banuta ({coord:32826,32576,7}). From there cross the jungle **southwest** to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to other cities.

Go to **Kazordoon** and look for the {wiki:Steamship}. You can travel directly from {wiki:Cormaya} or **Farmine**, cross the city's mine on foot or use the {wiki:Ore Wagon|Ore Wagons}. From Edron harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}); go down 8 floors to {npc:Gurbasch} and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}. You arrive at Kazordoon's underground harbour, next to {npc:Brodrosch}.

From the Steamship **go up 2 floors** to the main level, with {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves} and {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}. Head **southwest** and go down the hole into a room with a single {creature:Dwarf Guard}. Kill him.
Kazordoon mines map to the Dwarf Guard room
Open the {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door} to the **west** of the room and open the crate to find the {item:Old Iron}.
The quest door west of the room

Go back the same way: climb out through the hole with the {item:Rope}, head back **northeast** and go down the 2 floors to the Steamship. Talk to {npc:Brodrosch} and say {key:hi}, {key:cormaya} (or {key:farmine}) and {key:yes}; from Cormaya, {npc:Pemaret} at the north harbour takes you to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).

In **Thais**, follow the dirt path **north** to {wiki:Greenshore}. After crossing the bridge, look for a hole hidden behind a tree, a few steps **north** of the ramps, and go down. To get to Thais from another city, take the boat to Thais ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Bluebear}'s harbour.
Down there are {creature:Orc|Orcs} and {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}. Kill them and go down again. Follow the cave **south**, killing the orcs, and go down once more.
Map of the Greenshore orc cave
Watch out for the traps on the floor: they take off health.

Head a little **south** and then keep going **west** until the {wiki:Thais Dragon Lair|Greenshore Dragon Lair}. Go up and kill the {creature:Dragon}, which is accompanied by a {creature:Dragon Hatchling}.
Map of the path to the Dragon Lair and the quest door

In the **west** part of the lair, find a narrow corridor that leads to a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door}. Go in and kill {creature:Glitterscale} (roughly as strong as a Dragon). 'Use' the {item:Dead Glitterscale} to get the {item:Flexible Dragon Scale}.
The quest door in the Dragon Lair's west corridor

Go back the same way: come down from the lair, head **east** through the orc cave and go up the same way you came down (use the {item:Rope} on the holes) to the hole hidden behind the tree in Greenshore ({coord:32300,32097,7}). From there follow the dirt path **south** to Thais.
After handing in all 8 components, say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to {npc:Tereban}. He gives you the gold wrapped in an {item:Old Cape}.
8,000 experience, 8,000 gp and the Old Cape
